span.p:
Sprint orchestrates the others.
If invoked on an epic that hasn't been
preplanned or whose stories lack tasks,
Phase A and Phase B cascade-invoke
/dso:preplanning and
/dso:implementation-plan automatically.
You rarely need to invoke those directly.
